title: Urgent Order Volume Threshold Realignment

current_state.rule_expression: if order.is_urgent and order.quantity >= 100 then PRIORITY_HIGH else NORMAL

proposed_state.rule_expression: if order.is_urgent and order.quantity >= 200 then PRIORITY_HIGH else NORMAL

justification: Supplier production floor constraints require reserving expedited handling capacity strictly for major purchase volumes (>= 200 units) to reduce carrier surcharges.

governance_workflow.rollback_plan: Restore BR-1.0 threshold (100) via automated API rollback endpoint without downtime.
